summaries.summary: The page titled 'References/proof of our expertise' displays two sections: 'Mobile Operators' and 'Fixed Operators', each listing logos of various companies. The 'Mobile Operators' section contains logos of 10 distinct mobile operators, while the 'Fixed Operators' section lists 8 fixed operators. The footer indicates the document is from Alcatel-Lucent, dated 2012.
key_facts: The page is titled 'References/proof of our expertise'.
There are 10 mobile operators listed under the 'Mobile Operators' section.
There are 8 fixed operators listed under the 'Fixed Operators' section.
